title: BNB Sets $1,111 All-Time High as Network Activity Grows and Treasuries Continue Buying – $2,000 Possible?
summary: BNB surged to an all-time high of $1,111.90 on October 3 extending gains to 7.27% in 24 hours and triggering $268 million in short liquidations as the rally pushed BNB's market capitalization above $160 billion solidifying its position as the world's fourth-largest crypto while processing $3.74 billion in daily DEX volume.
